thig5.8:1.1: dasa putte vijāyitvā asmiṃ rūpasamussaye | tato 'haṃ dubbalā jiṇṇā bhikkhuniṃ upasaṅkamiṃ. || ||
thig5.8:2.1: sā me dhammam adesesi khandhāyatanadhātuyo | tassā dhammaṃ suṇitvāna kese chetvāna pabbajiṃ. || ||
thig5.8:3.1: tassā me sikkhamānāya dibbacakkhuṃ visodhitaṃ | pubbenivāsaṃ jānāmi yattha me vusitaṃ pure. || ||
thig5.8:4.1: animittañ ca bhāvemi ekaggā susamāhitā | anantarāvimokkhāsiṃ anupādāya nibbutā. || ||
thig5.8:5.1: pañca kkhandhā pariññātā tiṭṭhanti chinnamūlakā | ṭhitivatthuj' aneja mhi n' atthi dāni punabbhavo. || || Soṇā. ||
